verdict.rationale: Simular's open-source Agent S framework says the agent "looks at the screen" and acts by clicking, typing and scrolling in desktop and web apps. Platform docs say saved workflows consult the model "where the screen matters" and hand control back to the agent when the UI changes, so actions are grounded on the live display. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the capture/vision and grounding mechanism (screenshot cadence, element localization), independent or hands-on corroboration.
